First, convert 24 weeks and 4 days to days:  
24 weeks × 7 days/week = 168 days  
168 days + 4 days = 172 days  

Subtract 172 days from 1186-12-07:  
December 7, 1186 minus 172 days.  

Days in November 1186: 30  
Days in October 1186: 31  
Days in September 1186: 30  
Days in August 1186: 31  
Days in July 1186: 31  

From Dec 7: go back 7 days to Nov 30 (7 days used, 165 left).  
From Nov 30: back 30 days to Oct 31 (37 used, 135 left).  
From Oct 31: back 31 days to Sep 30 (68 used, 104 left).  
From Sep 30: back 30 days to Aug 31 (98 used, 74 left).  
From Aug 31: back 31 days to Jul 31 (129 used, 43 left).  
From Jul 31: back 31 days to Jun 30 (160 used, 12 left).  
From Jun 30: back 12 days to Jun 18.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1186-06-18
